metadata.title: UFF Sheridan Crucible v1.1.0: Survey-Aware Empirical Evaluation Engine
metadata.description: An exact, preregistration-ready reference implementation for evaluating frozen celestial-node claims under explicit survey geometry, completeness, masks, edge correction, competing nuisance models, predictive checks, and synthetic catalogue-level injection calibration. The framework produces SHA-256 evidence bundles and deterministic numerical replay. It tests catalogue associations and does not identify their physical cause.
